name: Midtempo grit stomp
desc: Halftime midtempo-bass stomp on the lo-fi EmuSP12: dragging kick with a ghost pickup, fat snare on 3, hats chewed by alternating coarse downsampling. Full layers clap ghosts; peak crushes the hat bus and doubles into machine-gun fills. Rezz/1788-L menace at 120.

code.full: stack(s("<[bd ~ [~ bd] ~] [bd ~ ~ ~]>").bank("EmuSP12").shape(.5).gain(${gain}), s("~ ~ sd ~").bank("EmuSP12").shape(.4).room(.25).gain(${gain}*.85), s("hh*4").bank("EmuSP12").coarse("<2 3 2 4>").gain(saw.range(${hats}*.5, ${hats}).fast(2)), s("~ [~ cp] ~ ~").bank("EmuSP12").gain(.3)).every(${fill}, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<[bd ~ [~ bd] ~] [bd [~ bd] ~ [bd bd]]>").bank("EmuSP12").shape(.55).gain(${gain}), s("~ ~ [sd,cp] ~").bank("EmuSP12").shape(.45).room(.3).gain(${gain}*.9), s("hh*8").bank("EmuSP12").coarse("<3 4>").crush(8).gain(saw.range(${hats}*.55, ${hats}).fast(4)), s("rim(5,16,<0 4>)").gain(.3)).lastOf(${fill}, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
